name: Akali

unused.W: Twilight Shroud deals no damage and its only fight-relevant effects (energy restore, +100 max energy, movement speed) do not matter against a stationary dummy: energy is not tracked (a full Q/E/R opening and continued Q spam never runs dry within 15s at level 16), and movement/stealth are irrelevant, so the driver never casts it.

notes: Casts go one at a time: a cast takes effect (its damage, if any) the instant it starts, then keeps Akali busy for its cast time, during which no other cast and no attack begins; one busy_until tracks this.

Perfect Execution (R) opens the fight: its initial dash deals damage as the cast starts, then its 0.25s cast time keeps Akali busy. The 2.5s static recast timer (unaffected by ability haste) is counted from that opening cast, per the dossier's 'within 10 seconds of the first activation'. The recast itself has no cast time (an instant dash that still cannot start inside another cast in progress), so it only applies the 0.25s attack lockout of a dash; its damage scales up to 3x the minimum on the target's missing health, capped at 70% missing.

Five Point Strike (Q) is cast the instant both its flat 1.5s cooldown and any cast in progress allow; its cast time scales from 0.25s at level 1 down to 0.175s at level 16 per the dossier's breakpoints (levels 1/6/11/16), and it keeps Akali busy for that long, delaying any other cast or attack.

Shuriken Flip (E) is cast on its cooldown; the initial cast (0.25s cast time) deals the smaller damage share and keeps Akali busy, then the recast is queued to fire the instant that busy window ends, consuming the mark for the larger damage share over its own 0.1s cast time (the sheet only gives one castTime field for E, so the recast's is taken from the wiki text). The game's forced basic attack after the recast dash lands is modeled as an attack reset to the moment that cast ends.

Assassin's Mark (P)'s Swinging Kama empowered attack is never triggered: it requires Akali to physically leave the ring created around a damaged champion and come back, but Q's short cooldown keeps refreshing the ring long before she could exit it, so casting Q on cooldown (the highest-damage use of that time) keeps the ring up indefinitely. P's on-hit bonus is therefore excluded from the rotation.

Twilight Shroud (W) is never cast: it deals no damage, and its energy/movement/stealth effects are irrelevant to a stationary dummy fight with mana/energy untracked (see the top-level 'unused' entry). Its 0.25s cast time is therefore moot, but is still recorded under gen.W.castTimeS from the wiki for reference.

Every damaging cast (both casts of E and R, and Q) triggers on-cast item effects (Spellblade priming, Muramana, Eclipse) separately, per the wiki's note that both casts of E and R count as distinct ability activations.

the numbers sheet's AkaliE only lists the initial cast's 0.25s cast time; the recast's 0.1s cast time is stated only in the wiki text
